storyPrompt: Write a quiet English story about checking a disputed delivery before a public demonstration. Anwen is a practical conservator. Tobin is an assistant who is allowed to disagree. Ruth keeps the public records. The story takes place at the clock workshop. The brass case must remain intact. No character may be physically injured. Keep practical actions precise. Use third-person past tense centred on Anwen. Plan six chapters, each targeting 750 words. No earlier book or borrowed fictional world is assumed.

texts:
Anwen received the sealed brass case and checked its outer label. The clock workshop was open, though there were no visitors at the table. Anwen cleared a space before setting anything down. Tobin moved the loose tools to a tray and waited for instructions. Neither of them treated a late delivery as proof of a lost object. They checked what they could see and left a blank beside what they could not yet establish.

The work required a little patience. A faded number was difficult to distinguish from a stain, so Anwen turned the sheet towards the window rather than writing over it. Tobin read the number aloud. They compared their readings, found that they agreed, and entered it only once. The brass case remained intact on the cleared table throughout the check.

Anwen made a short note of the work completed that day. The note separated observation from intention: a task written for tomorrow did not become a task already done. Tobin asked whether the uncertainty meant they should abandon the demonstration. Anwen said that an unanswered question was a reason to check, rather than a reason to invent an answer. It was an ordinary distinction, but making it aloud helped them continue without blaming anyone.

Anwen noticed a red seam but left it unopened. They put the tools back in the tray. Anwen recorded that result and closed the current work period. The next planned task remained unwritten in the story. No one had opened a different room, visited another site, or completed the later demonstration in the interval between these actions.
